conv_063.speaker: stoolpenny
conv_063.text: Has anyone seen a grey cart with a squeaky wheel? Someone took it off the {village} road last night.

conv_063.speaker: DawnwatchSeal
conv_063.text: I have seen no such cart, stoolpenny. Yet I shall watch for it at the {town} gate, as the dawn requires of me.

conv_063.speaker: stoolpenny
conv_063.text: Salt is up again. Nothing personal, but a cart full of salt does not walk off by itself, does it?

conv_063.speaker: DawnwatchSeal
conv_063.text: Let the dawn witness this oath, stoolpenny: should I find the thief, I will return your cart before the bells ring.

conv_063.speaker: stoolpenny
conv_063.text: Thank you. A thief who steals salt carts is a fool, and fools get caught in {town} sooner or later.

conv_063.speaker: DawnwatchSeal
conv_063.text: Then we are agreed. Two of our horses are also missing from the stable at {village}. Perhaps the losses share a hand.

conv_063.speaker: stoolpenny
conv_063.text: Two horses and a cart? Somebody is having a bad week. Keep your eyes open, friend, I will ask the carters.

conv_064.speaker: ConsulCometa
conv_064.text: A matter for the council, I think. Three horses have gone missing from the stables at {village}, and I have my suspicions.

conv_064.speaker: RavenVowhold
conv_064.text: Hear me, ConsulCometa, the ancestors are watching. Our old roads do not tolerate thieves, and neither do I.

conv_064.speaker: ConsulCometa
conv_064.text: How poetic, RavenVowhold. I merely ask who was seen near the {village} gate the night the horses left.

conv_064.speaker: RavenVowhold
conv_064.text: The ancestors saw everything, Consul. The question is whether you will admit your own carters lost their faith first.

conv_064.speaker: ConsulCometa
conv_064.text: Accusations are cheap in a republic. I would rather see a receipt than a riddle. Bring me proof and I will act.

conv_064.speaker: RavenVowhold
conv_064.text: Proof is for merchants. I bring you the oath of my blood, and it is worth more than your ledgers.

conv_064.speaker: ConsulCometa
conv_064.text: Then the council will decide, and I trust it more than blood. Good evening, RavenVowhold.
